verdict.rationale: A semantic layer is a fair question for a managed analytical database, since such platforms can ship governed metric and dimension definitions, so the axis applies. The evidence contains no semantic model where metrics, dimensions and joins are declared once and consumed consistently by queries and AI tools. Materialized views, dictionaries, CHKit schema-as-code and the MCP run-SQL tools are only building blocks or adjacent features, and they earn no credit toward this story.
